objective: Complete and audit every local prerequisite for a genuine aspect-first then sentiment taxonomy-generalisation suite before expensive online-GPU execution.

cloud_upload_must_exclude: any test-derived label or score artifact
sealed_data_contract.selection_population: seen-aspect validation labels within the exact outer training scope only

stage_1.output: one finite presence probability per review-candidate-aspect
stage_1.decoder: select every candidate aspect meeting the seen-only aspect threshold

stage_2.task: sentiment conditional on a selected candidate aspect
stage_2.execution: score only stage-1-selected aspects in the deployed pipeline
stage_2.evaluation_cache_permission: all sentiment scores may be computed before threshold selection only to permit deterministic validation and oracle-gated diagnostics
stage_2.primary_decoder: always emit top-1 sentiment and emit the runner-up only if its score meets a separately selected seen-only threshold

thresholds.aspect: selected first on seen-aspect validation evidence
thresholds.runner_up_sentiment: selected second with the aspect threshold frozen, on the same seen-only population
thresholds.sharing: one aspect threshold and one runner-up threshold per method and outer training scope; shared across every representation condition belonging to that scope

architecture.one_stage_role: matched architecture control only; never relabel one-stage checkpoints or scores as genuine two-stage artifacts

L3.heldout: two cyclic aspects A and B
L3.training: train exactly once per ten-seen-aspect scope using name plus minimal description
invariants: same checkpoint or frozen model across NN DN ND DD RR
same deterministic few-shot demonstrations across NN DN ND DD RR
same validation row identities across NN DN ND DD RR
same aspect and runner-up thresholds across NN DN ND DD RR
seen-candidate rendered prompts and raw scores are hash-identical across NN DN ND DD RR
both stages receive the same candidate representation within a condition
rich guidance contains aspect information only and never supplies candidate sentiment

few_shot.selection: stable SHA-256 order from the exact outer train fold; no retrieval and no result-guided selection

stage_2_demonstrations.eligibility: gold-present review-aspect instances with exactly one gold sentiment

few_shot.sharing: same demonstrations for every query and L3 condition inside one outer training scope
few_shot.truncation: preserve system instruction, all demonstration labels and query candidate; truncate review fields deterministically from the right only after segment-aware budgeting
few_shot.cache: separate from zero-shot with exact rendered-prompt hashes

distilbert_review_candidate_cross_encode.training: new genuine two-stage training; old pair checkpoints are control-only
distilbert_review_candidate_cross_encode.structure: two task-specific sequence classifiers initialized from the exact same pinned DistilBERT base revision: a binary aspect-presence classifier and a three-class conditional-sentiment classifier
distilbert_review_candidate_cross_encode.checkpointing: separate aspect and sentiment checkpoint hashes bound into one outer-scope two-stage checkpoint contract
distilbert_review_candidate_cross_encode.hyperparameter_selection: nested seen-only per exact outer training scope

qwen_candidate_pair_qlora.training: new genuine two-stage QLoRA training; old pair adapters are control-only
qwen_candidate_pair_qlora.adapter: one shared adapter per outer training scope with explicit aspect_presence and sentiment task prompts
qwen_candidate_pair_qlora.stage_2_balance: deterministic class-balanced allocation subject to observed support, with no duplicated identity
qwen_candidate_pair_qlora.grid_reuse_rule: the search range is reused but no historical selected learning rate is transferred
qwen_candidate_pair_qlora.hyperparameter_selection: nested seen-only per exact outer training scope
